# Tech Home TV

> Tech Home TV is a media player for Windows and Android. It does not provide channels, playlists, subscriptions, or media content. Users add sources they are authorized to use.

- Website: https://hm06601-crypto.github.io/tech-home-tv-v2/
- Windows and Android downloads: https://github.com/hm06601-crypto/tech-home-tv-v2/releases
- Source code: https://github.com/hm06601-crypto/tech-home-tv-v2
- Support phone: tel:+9647744644492
- Support website: https://techhome.ct.ws

Tech Home TV is based on IPTVnator and retains its MIT license and required upstream attribution.
